name: Realie
tagline: Nationwide property data API powered by AI-collected public records.
description: Realie is a property data platform that serves nationwide parcel, ownership, mortgage, and zoning data through a fast API. AI agents continuously collect records from public sources across 3,100+ U.S. counties in all 50 states, normalize the differing county layouts, and verify them so the data stays current. It handles search, lookups, and enrichment at sub-10ms latency, offers an automated valuation model and comparables, and supports full-state or nationwide bulk delivery via Amazon S3.
insight: Exposes its property data to AI coding tools — Claude, Cursor, and VS Code — over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
edge: Undercuts incumbent property-data APIs that start near $350/mo — a free tier and paid plans from $50/mo, with sub-10ms lookups and bulk S3 delivery.
pros: MCP access from Claude, Cursor, VS Code
cons: Newer and smaller than legacy data vendors
Public-record data can lag county updates
